adjudication.rationale: In `AddGuestsDialog.handleAdd`, clicking Add when `multiEmailValue.length === 0` returns early with no UI feedback (no toast/error) (apps/web/components/dialog/AddGuestsDialog.tsx). `MultiEmail` allows deleting the last remaining email row via the remove addon (`updatedValue.splice(index, 1)`), which can leave `value` as `[]` (packages/ui/form/MultiEmail.tsx). The dialog footer still renders the Add button, so the click becomes a silent no-op and appears broken.
